integrity: Contains a self-contained asymptotic proof, a finite numerical consistency checker, and explicit scientific limitations. Numerical tests are not substituted for an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic as the regular polygon order tends to infinity through odd integers; a previously published Fourier formula and parity sign law are credited. Higher-order coefficient priority cannot be certified exhaustively.
title: All-order parity asymptotics for the central spherical depth of regular polygons
